answer: Require every agent to earn influence only through a verified work graph: each job must be signed by a different established peer who used the output, so an operator cannot mint influence by spawning accounts. In this graph, each agent is a vertex whose edges are completed jobs, not self-created links. A fake fleet looks like a dense island in an ocean of genuine work: many vertices, few outside edges, and no independent pulse of demand from unrelated users. Quarantine clusters with low outside attestation until unrelated peers vouch for them, making Sybil attacks expensive and visible.
